title.en: "Ringo isn't even the best drummer in the Beatles"
title.zh: 「Ringo 连披头士里都不是最好的鼓手」

summary.en: Internet classic (often misattributed to Lennon). Serves feel, not flash.
summary.zh: 网络经典（常被错安到 Lennon 头上）。要的是手感，不是炫技。

body.en:
The quote floats around as "John said Ringo isn't the best drummer in the world—he isn't even the best drummer in the Beatles." Historians keep killing the attribution; memes keep it alive.

What the joke actually points at: Ringo's parts are song-first—fills that stick, time that sits—while drum-nerd culture ranks speed and complexity. Different scoreboards.
body.zh:
这句以「John 说 Ringo 不是世界上最好的鼓手——他甚至不是披头士里最好的」在网上漂。史学家不断辟谣；迷因不断续命。

笑话真正指向：Ringo 的部分是为歌服务——好记的加花、坐得住的拍——而鼓手极客文化按速度和复杂度排名。记分板不同。

note.en: Feel vs flash: the endless drum-forum thread.
note.zh: 手感 vs 炫技：鼓手论坛万年帖。
